name: Coin of Fate
oracle_text:
When this artifact enters, surveil 1.
{3}{W}, {T}, Exile two creature cards from your graveyard, Sacrifice this artifact: An opponent chooses one of the exiled cards. You put that card on the bottom of your library and return the other to the battlefield tapped. You become the monarch.
blocked_sentences: {3}{W}, {T}, Exile two creature cards from your graveyard, Sacrifice this artifact: An opponent chooses one of the exiled cards. You put that card on the bottom of your library and return the other to the battlefield tapped. You become the monarch.

needs.what: an `as` key on the `exile_from_graveyard` cost that binds the cards it exiled (the way `tap_permanents` and `sacrifice` take `as`), so the ability's effects can select exactly those cards in exile -- here an opponent-chosen one of them (selector `chooser: "opponent"`, count 1) put on the bottom of its owner's library, and the other returned to the battlefield tapped
needs.why_existing_wont_do: costs.pay's exile_from_graveyard branch exiles via zones.exile with cause="cost" and neither writes a binding nor calls link_exiled, so `exiled_with: "self"` matches nothing and no binding names the paid cards; a plain `{"zone": "exile"}` selector would reach every exiled card in the game, a different card
